race.comment: STEADY ON (6) travelled in the leading division and looked a chance but just missed the placings last start over 1700m at Grafton. Racing well and this step back in distance looks the right move. Big chance in an open race. OCCUPATION (5) produced a real eye-catcher last time out at Grafton when lining up for only the second time. Settled worse than midfield that day then unleashed late to be beaten under a length at the end of 1410m. This looks the perfect follow-up assignment. HABIB ALBI (2) chalked up a third career placing from six outings when he led then held on well for third recently over 1700m at Grafton. Chopping and changing his distances but is coping well and should give a great sight again. ZAYYANO (8) led but couldn't keep going in a 1630m Grafton maiden last start. Should race handy and can run a cheeky race. MILITARY LEGEND (10) next best but does step up sharply in distance.
